name: @r1ck404/fast-acorn
description: Faster drop-in replacement for acorn 8.18: identical ASTs, errors and callbacks, 2.5-3x faster parsing, fast paths for acorn-jsx and parseFunctionBody overrides
author: R1ck404 (https://github.com/R1ck404)

scripts.gen: node tools/gen-ident.mjs && node tools/gen-regexp.mjs && node tools/gen-jsx-data.mjs && node tools/gen-generic.mjs
scripts.test: node test/string-scan.mjs && node test/bundle.mjs --limit 60 && node test/differences.mjs && node test/comments.mjs && node test/options.mjs && node test/diff.mjs --limit 800 && node test/versions.mjs --limit 40 --soup 20000 && node test/plugins.mjs --limit 60
scripts.test:full: node test/bundle.mjs && node test/differences.mjs && node test/comments.mjs && node test/options.mjs && node --stack-size=4000 test/diff.mjs --locs --comments --nodepod && node test/expr-diff.mjs && node --stack-size=4000 test/jsx-diff.mjs && node --stack-size=4000 test/override-diff.mjs && node --stack-size=4000 test/error-diff.mjs && node --stack-size=4000 test/acorn-diff.mjs && node --stack-size=4000 test/versions.mjs && node --stack-size=4000 test/plugins.mjs
